claim: For the real Day--James plane \(X=\ell_2-\ell_\infty\), with \(\|(u,v)\|_{2,\infty}=\sqrt{u^2+v^2}\) when \(uv\ge0\) and \(\|(u,v)\|_{2,\infty}=\max\{|u|,|v|\}\) when \(uv\le0\), the Ptolemy constant is exactly \(C_{\mathrm{Pt}}(X)=3/2\).
integrity: The equality follows from a complete Hilbert-comparison upper bound and an exact attaining configuration. Literature noncoverage claims are limited to material actually inspected.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is proved only for the stated real two-dimensional Day--James norm. The originality comparison retains an access risk for Zuo (2015), DOI 10.12386/A2015sxxb0033, because a readable full text could not be obtained.
title: Exact Ptolemy constant of the Day--James \(\ell_2-\ell_\infty\) plane
